Part Two

What is an LLM?

2
A new kind of resource:
general-purpose intelligence,
bought by the token
(somewhat)
From outside, looking in
f : String -> String

Outside the API boundary, this is the observable behaviour.

No hidden state is carried between calls.

Nondeterministic

"What is spin?"

→

"Spin is..."

"Angular..."

"In QM..."

Same input, different outputs: the model samples from P(next token | context)

Temperature
P(token_i) = exp(ℓ_i/T) / Σ_j exp(ℓ_j/T)
0.1 · ground state3.0 · hot
The electron has

Direct analogy to the Boltzmann distribution. Low T freezes into the ground state; high T melts toward uniform.

Tokens

Not characters. Not words.

Subword chunks from a fixed vocabulary V of about 100k entries.

'theoretical physics' -> ['theor', 'etical', ' physics']

More precisely: f : Token* → Token*

An LLM is a stateless, nondeterministic function
f : String -> String
that samples from P(next_token | context)
via a single forward pass through a frozen neural network
Part Three

The illusion of chat

3
A single API call
curl https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages \ -H "x-api-key: $KEY" \ -H "content-type: application/json" \ -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \ -d '{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6", "max_tokens":256, "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is a quark?"}]}'

One string in, one string out: the entire interaction

How chat works
Turn 1: [user_1] Turn 2: [user_1, asst_1, user_2] Turn 3: [user_1, asst_1, user_2, asst_2, user_3]

The client re-sends the entire history every turn: the LLM has no memory.

The context window
system
summary
fresh space
system prompt conversation turns compacted summary
Everything the model sees must fit here: a few thousand tokens up to about 1M at the frontier.
Chat interfaces do this silently
Your constraints, instructions, and earlier results quietly disappear.
This is why long chats go off the rails.
Part Four

From function to agent

4
The agent loop
while not done: response = llm(system_prompt + history) tool_calls = parse(response) results = execute(tool_calls) history += [response, results]

The complete architecture of every coding agent

The LLM never executes anything
It generates text; your scaffolding acts on it.
Closing the loop
Chat

open loop

errors compound

tool results feed back
→
Agent

closed loop

errors correct

A failing test, a stack trace, a wrong number: each becomes the next correction.

Feedback stabilises an otherwise unstable system

The filesystem is permanent memory
Chat

context is the only state

it evaporates when the window fills

rots, cannot be checked

Agent

the filesystem is the state

it survives the context window

persistent, checkable, versioned

(i) memory that outlives the context window; (ii) ground truth the model can re-read instead of half-remembering.

The radical unlock versus chat

Subagents
Supervisor

delegates and composes reports

Worker

fresh context

Worker

fresh context

Worker

fresh context

Each worker gets a clean window; results return as short reports.

Context isolation is the point

Adversarial verification
Prover

constructs

→
Verifier

attacks

→
Formaliser

Lean proof

Natural language is an inadequate verification mechanism

Formal proof = a compiler for mathematics

The harder problem

7
Why LLMs fail at research
Undergraduate

Every step spelled out

Pedagogical structure

LLMs excel

phase transition
→
Research

"By standard arguments"

Compressed communication

LLMs fail

Models reproduce the texture of expertise, not the logic beneath it

The renaissance expert
Old cost structure

Years of apprenticeship

Deep, slow immersion

One domain per career

agentic AI
→
New cost structure

Hours to operational competence

Implementation is nearly free

Portfolio across domains

When execution is commoditized, the bottleneck shifts to problem formulation

The single point of failure

Code has compilers. Proofs have proof assistants.

Planning documents have nothing.

You can verify that code implements a spec.

You cannot verify that the spec addresses the right problem.

The scarce resource is structural taste: knowing which problems are load-bearing and which are decorative

"Trust arrives on foot
and leaves on horseback"
Dutch proverb
A good mental model of an LLM:
a slightly unhinged,
hypermotivated MSc student
brilliant, tireless, and never to be taken on trust
How trust is actually built

Trust is not granted; it is verified into existence.

The foundation is ground truth: primary sources, raw data, the actual output.

The masters of this: investigative journalists. every claim traced to a source, checked independently.

Cultivate the investigative mindset

Every layer we built today has failure modes
Context rot, hallucination, tool misuse, prompt fragility
The human in the loop is not optional
You can outsource cognition
but you can't outsource understanding
Summary

LLMs are stateless functions: not magic, not minds

Agents are loops: scaffolding provides the action

The filesystem is ground truth: memory that survives and can be checked

The human provides taste: technique over hype
